name: Empini
description: A vengeful daughter makes it her mission to repay her father's betrayal. She infiltrate's the shady world of VIP security to face a man who is hardened by political enemies.

videos.title: Comrades, I Greet You In The Name Of Freedom
videos.overview: A vengeful daughter makes it her mission to repay het father's betrayal. She infiltrate's the shady world of VIP security to face a man who is hardened by political enemies.

videos.title: I'm Bg 1 Now
videos.overview: Ndoni's investigation seems to have reached a dead end, but a crucial discovery changes everything. Uhuru gets told to suck it up and do what he needs to do.

videos.title: Speak Now, Or Forever Hold Your Grave
videos.overview: Ndoni vows to avenge her father, while Madlopa and Lufuno do their best to help. Khaya deals with Enoch's assailant. Uhuru shows his true colors.

videos.title: The Devil And The Details
videos.overview: Ndoni seeks answers from her father's lost diary while Khaya struggles to mediate between General and Enoch. Nosipho makes a bold move regarding her future with Uhuru.

videos.title: His Things Are Yours, Too
videos.overview: Ndoni discovers a link to her father's past. Khaya tries to get Enoch and General to behave at dinner. Nosipho gets isolated by a flock of fake friends.

videos.title: I Don't Know Where To Put My Gun
videos.overview: Ndoni discovers a new clue in her father's diary.

videos.title: It's Written In Code
videos.overview: A big break in her investigation forces Ndoni to consider her course. General seeks to destroy Enoch once and for all. Love is on the line as Blaza makes an impassioned plea.

videos.title: Consider All Your Angels
videos.overview: Tension rises as Ndoni takes matters into her own hands. General and Khaya receive a devastating blow. Trash music leads to Mkhonto's humiliation.

videos.title: Do They Still Sell Newspapers?
videos.overview: Secrets prove life-threatening, and Ndoni makes a drastic decision. General aims at Khaya. Nosipho gets more evidence of Uhuru's apathy.

videos.title: You're Only As Good As Your Next Election
videos.overview: Ndoni uses extreme tactics to extract information. Khaya give Uhuru a lesson. General tells his son that he has family responsibilities to live up to.

videos.title: The Circle of Life
videos.overview: Ndoni grapples with a difficult moral choice and comes to a dark decision. Nosipho takes charge to protect her interest. Mkhonto has a tantrum over his right to show of his talent.

videos.title: Marriage: A Union of Comrades
videos.overview: Khaya does what he can to dissuade Enoch from taking drastic actions. Nosipho decides to tough it out with Uhuru by her side. Ndoni is resolute in her choice to cause the utmost pain.

videos.title: Find the Bullet, Find the Traitor
videos.overview: Ndoni get's another opportunity to exact revenge as a tragic shooting rocks the world of MPS.

videos.title: Escape and Intrigue
videos.overview: Ndoni and Thobani are on a collision course. Khaya does his best to escape danger. Vutha and Sbamu try to save their jobs. Death reigns supreme.

videos.title: The Hidden Truths
videos.overview: The aftermath of a tragic loss leaves the Bhodoza house crumbling. General scrambles to find out the truth. A funeral leaves Ndoni lost and without a goal.

videos.title: Restless Shadows
videos.overview: Ndoni seeks solace from Jabulani. Mkhonto refuses to believe the events of the past few days. Masasa arrives and makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Unearthed Secrets
videos.overview: Khaya's past is put on display as Masasa recalls the events of more than 30 years ago.

videos.title: Hidden Agendas
videos.overview: General pressures Uhuru to seize power from MPS. Mkhonto attempts something similar, taking responsibility as best he can. Masasa's son, Senzele, seeks the truth.

videos.title: Beneath the Surface
videos.overview: Senzele's true parentage is revealed. Ndoni finally confides in her mother. The future of MPS's leadership is in question as Khaya's will is read.

videos.title: Twisted Loyalties
videos.overview: Thobani and Mkhonto clash as the young pseudo-CEO does not understand the nature of leadership. Enoch is put under pressure by the public. Jabulani confesses.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: Jabulani is hurt when Ndoni leaves unexpectedly. Masasa and her partner fight over Masasa's house guest. Uhuru is given more responsibilities.

videos.title: Lines in the Sand
videos.overview: Panic erupts as confidence in MPS is dwelling. A new client allows Ndoni to show her potential. Mzoxolo decides to prioritize himself over his relationship.

videos.title: Family Ties
videos.overview: Senzele's father gets the blame for disrupting Masasa's life. Nosipho supports Uhuru over General's impact on their marriage. Ndoni makes a disturbing dicovery regarding MPS's newest client.

videos.title: Unveiling Shadows
videos.overview: Ndoni investigates the pastor - against MPS's instructions. Senzele learns about his siblings and his father's legacy. The pastor retaliates against MPS and Ndoni.

videos.title: Turning Points
videos.overview: Ndoni's persistence has grave consequences. Masasa is adamant that Senzele will not get involved in his father's business. The ownership of MPS is once again up in the air.

videos.title: The Apple Didn't Fall Far
videos.overview: Ndoni has to redeem herself for losing MPS a client. Senzele refuses his father's request to take over MPS. Ndoni's moral efforts are finally rewarded.

videos.title: Welcome to Joburg
videos.overview: Senzele arrives in Joburg, shaking up the leadership of MPS, but danger lurks around every corner. Ndoni is given more responsibilities.

videos.title: People Aren't Who They Say They Are
videos.overview: Winnie suffers the humiliation of the truth of Senzele's existence. Ndoni offers her support to Senzele, who proves skilled at navigating this dangerous world.

videos.title: Brother From Another Mother
videos.overview: Zenzele soaks up the unyielding power that comes with running MPS. Mkhonto ignores his mother's wishes to stay away from his new sibling.

videos.title: Your Vote, Your Voice
videos.overview: Zenzele's honesty about his father reminds Ndoni of her love for MPS and Bonga. Winnie spirals with a drastic request for Enoch. Thobani urges Zenzele to see MPS for what it is.

videos.title: Everybody Needs a Bodyguard
videos.overview: Khaya invokes the next phase of his plan by setting Zenzele's eyes on Enoch. Madlopa warns Ndoni about believing anything Zenzele says, but she isn't sure who to trust.

videos.title: If At First You Don't Succeed, Shoot Again
videos.overview: Zenzele finally learns how far his enemies will go to destroy him. Mkhonto and Nosipho attempts a new peace offering for their mother. Jabulani shoves new boundaries between him and Ndoni.

videos.title: The Alpha Protection Team
videos.overview: Mkhonto has an epiphany of what his fresh, new life at MPS could be like. Ndoni decides the only way to find the truth behind Zenzele is to keep him close secretly.

videos.title: Always Hide Your Gun
videos.overview: Thobani blames what happened to Zenzele on Ndoni's reckless decisions. The weight of staying in Johannesburg melts Zenzele's stubborn resolve. Winnie's greatest fear comes alive.

videos.title: I'm Not a Babysitter
videos.overview: Khaya reaffirms Zenzele's dangerous suspicions towards General. Jabulani accidentally spills the secret behind the Alpha Team's deadly power, and Mkhonto takes it to heart.

videos.title: Duck, Duck, Roll
videos.overview: Ndoni struggles to understand why Zenzele reassigned her to a new client. Mkhonto takes extreme measures to prove he has what it takes to make it at MPS.

videos.title: The Boys that Disappeared
videos.overview: Zenzele gets information that changes the way he sees his father. Ndoni and Dora celebrate Bonga's memory and birthday. Striker learns the dangerous source behind Mkhonto's new energy.

videos.title: We Could be Allies
videos.overview: Ndoni stops the worst from happening to her client and later finds out her colleagues want little to do with her. Zenzele gets ready to use the bomb of information he's found against General.

videos.title: She's a Walking Grenade
videos.overview: Ndoni faces another suspension and turns to an old friend to distract her. Zenzele takes bigger strides in being the boss and secures interesting information from Enoch.

videos.title: In the Name of Bonga Themba
videos.overview: The Bhodoza family forces Winnie to accept Zenzele for the day. Ndoni spends the day with Dora.

videos.title: Comrades Don't Run Against Each Other
videos.overview: Zenzele finds out the truth behind his assassination attempt and confides in Ndoni. Masasa avoids Khaya like the plague, annoyed with herself for being so weak.

videos.title: You Won't Be the Actual President
videos.overview: The fight for the deputy president intensifies as General tries to reclaim his position. Khaya gets kicked out of the house by Masasa.

videos.title: Teacher's Pet
videos.overview: Thanks to Zenzele's influence, Ndoni's suspension is lifted. However, Ndoni wants to keep their budding romance a secret and away from MPS ears.

videos.title: The Grenade
videos.overview: Ndoni is finally reassigned back to Amahle and vows to keep her safe, which proves harder than expected when the little girl gets kidnapped. Winnie and Striker get to know each other.

videos.title: Thank You for Your Service, Comrade
videos.overview: Ndoni and Senzele face serious difficulties. General admits he was wrong to Thobani, who is not receptive. Uhuru finally catches a break.

videos.title: Do You Want to be Together?
videos.overview: Ndoni numbs herself to the people around her following her outburst with Zenzele, who tries his best to get her to open up. General tries picking up the pieces following his dismissal at the NIA.

videos.title: Things Fall Apart
videos.overview: Walls are closing in on Khaya. Mkhonto is happy to have Uhuru move in.

videos.title: It Always Gets Hard
videos.overview: Ndoni confesses the truth about her past and medication to Zenzele. Thobani finds himself in deep water when General turns on him. Uhuru and Nosipho finds themselves chased by journalists.

videos.title: Nothing Personal
videos.overview: As Ndoni lets down her walls with Zenzele, she starts to feel like he might be skillfully hunting the hunter. General tries to apologize to Thobani.

videos.title: Comrades Never Die
videos.overview: Ndoni tells Zenzele about her father's death and her suspicion that Khaya was behind it. Mzoxolo arrives at MPS and figures out who Khaya really is. Mkhonto tries to get rid of Striker.

videos.title: A Picture is Worth 1000 Bullets
videos.overview: Madlopa warns Ndoni about offloading her suspicious nature onto Zenzele. Set on catching Zenzele doing something bad, Thobani and General stumble upon a conversation about Khaya.

videos.title: Biting the Bullet/Hellfire
videos.overview: Ndoni has a bad feeling when she arrives in Kokstad to confront Khaya. Masasa and Mzoxolo's lobola negotiations go off without a hitch. Zenzele is alerted about the General's impending doom.

videos.title: Welcome Home
videos.overview: Ndoni and Khaya have some explaining to do to the police. Masasa and Zenzele grieve Mzoxolo. Meanwhile, the Bhodoza family is placed on lockdown.

videos.title: The Return of Khaya Bhodoza
videos.overview: Khaya returns to his family, and MPS readies to join forces with Zenzele, but the boy couldnt care less. Dora worries about Ndoni and her escapades with Madlopa.

videos.title: My Comrade, My Friend
videos.overview: Ndoni is determined to move on with her life while giving Zenzele the cold shoulder at work. General wins the support of his party members despite being suspended. Khaya apologizes to Uhuru.

videos.title: Forgiveness is a Curse
videos.overview: Khaya struggles to find a person in his world who will stand by his side as the power struggle for MPS begins. Masasa advises Zenzele to consider going back to Kokstad.

videos.title: Keep Your Comrades Close and Their Wives Closer
videos.overview: Khaya and General keep playing their cat-and-mouse game. Khaya is adamant about making General sweat. Ndoni learns the truth about Nosipho and Jabulani's relationship.

videos.title: Pawns
videos.overview: A better resolution comes straight to Ndoni's door. Enoch uses General's low point to put him in a corner. Uhuru struggles with feelings of inadequacy and finds an ally in Zenzele.

videos.title: The Darkest Night
videos.overview: Khaya spins Ndoni the story of a troubled Bonga who was killed by a random killer while setting General up as her next target. Winnie and Striker have an eventful parting.

videos.title: Comrades Don't Die
videos.overview: Ndoni turns her suspicions to General and resolves to take him down. Khaya tries to assuage Ndoni's suspicions of him by bringing Madlopa to book and taking out General.

videos.title: The Rise and Fall of Gilbert
videos.overview: When Ndoni discovers Madlopa near death, she reconsiders her quest to find her father's killer. Uhuru finds out the unspectacular details of his father's death.

videos.title: It's Your Job to Shoot Them
videos.overview: Ndoni makes peace with Khaya, Zenzele and Dingane. She returns to active duty at MPS, guarding an unsavory character. Uhuru rededicates himself to his marriage.

videos.title: Manipulate, If You Must
videos.overview: Ndoni tries to make things right when she learns of Miss Kay's actions. Khaya distracts Zenzele in a ploy to get close to Masasa. Winnie tries to make a solid decision about her marriage.

videos.title: Forbidden
videos.overview: Khaya and Masasa have opened the floodgates as they can't seem to stay away from one another. Nosipho struggles to be there for Uhuru at a time of need when her own heart wants to leave him.

videos.title: We Don't Question Our Parents
videos.overview: Mthunzi's lobola makes everyone happy except for him. Nyakallo relies on Disebo's powers to help her fall pregnant again. Sihle inadvertently gets her husband arrested.

videos.title: For Better or Worse
videos.overview: Winnie sees Striker one last time before suggesting that she and Khaya renew their vows. Zenzele realises his father doesn't mind replacing him at the office. Mkhonto pitches an idea that could bring MPS revenue.

videos.title: A Man Can't Have to Many Sons
videos.overview: Nosipho promises to make it up to Jabulani, while Uhuru is encouraged to make political power plays. Zenzele wants to show support to the Bhadoza family by asking to speak at Khaya and Winnie's anniversary dinner.

videos.title: My Client is Your Client
videos.overview: Mkhonto gives Sbamu and Vuntha their first client without Khaya's knowledge. Winnie sets out to reconnect with Khaya and plan their anniversary despite her husband's blatant disregard.

videos.title: Wolf In Bodyguard's Clothing
videos.overview: Dingane tells Khaya that Striker and Winnie are having an affair. Masasa is hurt when Zenzele makes a speech at Khaya and Winnie's anniversary party.

videos.title: What Are The Odds?
videos.overview: Khaya keeps a keen eye on Winnie and Striker. Dingane gets a cash boost thanks to his role as Khaya's mole, but his conscience is unsettled because he betrayed Striker.

videos.title: The Footage Doesn't Lie
videos.overview: Khaya gets his hands on footage that confirms Winnie and Striker's relationship. Nosipho begs Jabulani to not give up on their relationship.

videos.title: Consequence Management
videos.overview: Winnie feels Khaya is avoiding her. She says her goodbyes to Khaya. Uhuru endeavors to support Enoch publicly and finally meets Justice Mahlangu, the man running against Enoch.

videos.title: Demotion
videos.overview: Kaya exacts his revenge on Striker and finally confronts Winnie about her affair. Enoch continues to be frustrated by Justice and enlists Uhuru's help.

videos.title: Shots Fired
videos.overview: Khaya takes his dislikes for Striker to dangerous lengths. Uhuru puts himself in the spotlight to regain the trust and respect of his father-in-law and grandfather-in-law.

videos.title: A Reckoning
videos.overview: Khaya interrogates Striker, Vutha and Dora. Nosipho tries to find Jabulani's missing belt, but Uhuru discovers he is wearing it.

videos.title: Striker While the Iron is Hot
videos.overview: Mkhonto seems to be the only one concerned about Striker's whereabouts. With Enoch endorsing Uhuru as a son-in-law and future political ally, Uhuru ponders what to do with his suspicions about his wife's cheating.

videos.title: Flying Close to the Sun
videos.overview: Under duress, Jabulani breaks up with Nosipho. She runs into Uhuru's arms for comfort.

videos.title: Missing and Missed
videos.overview: Pressure mounts on the Bhodozas around Striker's disappearance. Mkhonto reports him missing, and Khaya makes a startling confession to Thobani. Nosipho nurses a broken heart.

videos.title: Closure
videos.overview: Winnie pleads with Khaya to give Striker's family and loved ones closure about his disappearance. Nosipho confronts Jabulani for manipulating her into falling for him.

videos.title: Damsel in Distress
videos.overview: Khaya wants to put the Striker matter behind him, but Winnie is inconsolable over Striker's death. While her husband plays puppet to Khaya and Enoch, Nosipho worries about her mother's grief over Striker's death.

videos.title: I'm Nothing Like You
videos.overview: Winnie asks for a divorce. Justice challenges Enoch to a debate, and Nosipho and Uhuru pull together to manage the situation.

videos.title: Mutually Assured Destruction
videos.overview: Winnie is still dead set on divorcing Khaya, but Enoch convinces her to get more out of the relationship. Uhuru learns how he got his job at MPS.

videos.title: The Next Best CEO
videos.overview: Khaya announces that he will no longer be part of MPS's core structure, sending everyone into a paranoid frenzy about what he might be planning. Nosipho works out how to fix things in her marriage.

videos.title: Good Bodyguard, Bad Bodyguard
videos.overview: Khaya extends a hand of support to Justice in his bid to overthrow Enoch as deputy president. Uhuru and Thobani finds themselves resigning from MPS but for different reasons.

videos.title: You're My Equal
videos.overview: Weapons are missing from MPS and Thobani convinces Zenzele to cover it up. A mysterious visitor approaches Thobani, requesting he fulfil a promise for a long-missing friend.

videos.title: Political Partners
videos.overview: Zenzele grapples with the best way for MPS to move forward, despite the whole team working against his orders. Ndoni and Jabulani try their best to find more clues about the missing guns.

videos.title: I Know Who Killed Our Leader
videos.overview: Thobani does't give up until Nombulelo gives him the truth, while Zenzele promises Enoch he'll transport his mysterious cargo. Justice refuses to give up on a possible future with Dora.

videos.title: Mbali's First Mission
videos.overview: Mbali gets an opportunity to make a name for herself at MPS when Zenzele assigns her to one of their biggest protection jobs. Justice makes his intentions clear to Dora.

videos.title: I Don't Play Games With My Money
videos.overview: Zenzele and the rest of MPS are left reeling at the failure of their mission as Enoch puts a bounty on the company's tender. Jabulani finds himself at the head of suspicion as Mbali tries to find the mole.

videos.title: My Comrade Didn't Make It
videos.overview: Zenzele scrambles for help to deal with the wrath of the deputy president. Ndoni finds out what Nombulelo does for a living and pieces together a big secret.

videos.title: I Thought We Were Friends
videos.overview: Enoch suspects Justice is behind the ambush, and Justice is revealed to be in cahoots with Dingane and Khaya. Zenzele feels betrayed by Thobani and Ndoni.

videos.title: Don't Burst My Bubble
videos.overview: Zenzele and Thobani place Jabulani on surveillance for Justice. Enoch rallies Dora for her apartment funds as he secretly tries to make up for the money he lost.

videos.title: Fall From Grace
videos.overview: Under pressure from Enoch, Zenzele tells the MPS team to bug Justice's phone to learn more about his scandalous activities. Jabulani comes face to face with the real men behind the heist.

videos.title: You're Not a Fool
videos.overview: Justice and Khaya scatter to find a way to get their funds cleaned. Thobani decides to make a play for MPS. Uhuru learns that working with the public isn't always glamorous.

videos.title: The New And Improved Deputy President
